Messages.Author: johannes
Messages.Body:
Deck Name: Immer mitten in die Fresse rein
Author: Johannes Walch
Description: I built the deck on the idea of wanting a combat deck that can handle Animalism well. This one can because I stay close, strike harder and Taste and they most likely don´t. It can also handle S:CE quite well, 10-cap is hard to Obedience and at least Cailean handles Guns. Apparently it hates VIC combat. On top of that a strong defense module so I only need to back rush when there are big voters.

Managed 2nd place in German Qualifier, tied with 1,5VP in the finals but worse pre-final standing.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
I like the concept. I had tried to do something similar with flesh of marble, but never got something good from it.

On topic :

* why fist of death instead of torn signpost ? You fear being unable to play them before having a preternatural strength ?

* By what would you replace Deep song if unavailable ? A mix of rush card and govern the unaligned ?

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: Torn Signpost don't mix well with Preternatural Strength.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> extrala wrote:
> Torn Signpost don't mix well with Preternatural Strength.
>
Then again, the advantage to occasionaly be able to hit for 5 or cycle the card seem not that important compared to the 1 blood cost.

I may be wrong, but the deck seem to have Fist of death primary for when a minion have neither preternatural strength nor a built in strength bonus enter combat. Torn signpost seem stronger in thoses cases (since you don't have to pay blood), while being weaker when thing go smoothly and you already have a frightful minion. That's why the choice seem counter-intuitive for me.

Messages.Author: johannes
Messages.Body:
> Ohlmann wrote:
> * why fist of death instead of torn signpost ? You fear being unable to play them before having a preternatural strength ?
>
I don´t like dead cards. Once I have one or two Prenaturals these are really dead. Also they stack when you happen to have both in hand. Torn Signpost would be an equally good choice, tough.
>
> Ohlmann wrote:
> * By what would you replace Deep song if unavailable ? A mix of rush card and govern the unaligned ?
>
I think the deck is impossible without Deep Song. The versatility is key, always having rush or bleed depending if you need to oust or to torpor.

I would appreciate some suggestion on what to use instead of Monster. Preferrably cards without pool cost, or one maximum.

Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
> johannes wrote:
> I would appreciate some suggestion on what to use instead of Monster. Preferrably cards without pool cost, or one maximum.
>
I like having two copies of The Freeness (Nos Kingdom, in this case) in decks with libraries this big. It's a great card if you draw it early on, but not often later, so doubling your chances of getting it early is worth the later discard if you see the second copy.

Toolbox decks usually benefit from having Barrens or Elder Library. Alternatively, just put some non-master in the deck; 19 seems high to me, given that you've got the potential to play a lot of cards between your master phases.

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
Unbelievable... I did the exact same thing - downsize to 80 and shoehorn in 2 Conditionings and 2 Abbots. I considered a Kevlar Vest too, but decided it's an action you can't afford to take with the few you have available.

What you posted there is almost down to the card what I had made of it when I played around with it a bit. Seriously, this is scary. What I have compared to this is:

-3 rat's warning
-2 Slam
+2 Earthshock
+1 Cat's Guidance
+1 Deep Song
+1 Enkil Cog

It looks pretty nice deck, but in the end it's way too vulnerable to Pentex for my taste. Cailean gets a Pentex and you're basically fucked. I also feel it pretty slow having to bring out multiple fatties without acceleration and forward motion consisting of bleeds for 2 or the occasional Fame dunk.

I have been trying to make ani/dom crypts work for quite a while now and usually end up in group 3/4. I'll certainly give this version a spin on a fridag night session when I get around building some new decks though.

> No Beast? Big Hands compensate for small Crows.
>
I toyed with that idea, but Beast can't use Deep Song so all he really is is a rush and +1 strength. That's fairly expensive for 7 pool, especially since he can't properly play Sense the Savage Way either and with 10+ Deep Songs it's not like you're going to be short on rush.

Messages.Author: Poci
Messages.Body:
I love the original deck! Simple, lean and clear cut, but some modifications I would imply:

-Smiling - you simply don't have the time for that and just generates the table hate (which you'll get anyway with this deck, sooner rather than later).

-3 sense the savage way - no serious reason to untap, just to deflect, and it stucks in your hand. Maybe 2 Slam would be useful.

-2 monsters should stay, in my opinion. Yeah, costly, but definitely worth it! If you decide against them, than it shold be Conditionings.

-I'm still considering it, but nowadays I'm thinking seriously using some (2-4) street creds in this type of decks. Not expected, and saves the bloating action (and if this deck hits, then it hits way more that the opposing one). I would add 2, (sub the smiling and a sense).

>
> I would also be tempted to try Nahir. +1 bleed and +X hand size should be great in a deck like this and Swalloweds might as well be Slams and Mighty Grapples.

Swalloweds are very useful to get your rush past Jake Washington and also they gave me a VP on two occasions because of the stealth on a bleed.

Thanks a lot for the very good suggestions. Abbott is certainly going in. I thought about bringing the deck down to 80 or 75, but it flows very quickly and with the Dreams .. I did actually run out of cards twice with this deck already.

I wouldn't add Wash. It is too prayerish against Pentex and will just stay in your hand and make deck flow worse. Carlton and Mylan are ok against Pentex if your metagame has not become more combat happy also. With that kind of crypt I feel you have to just accept to get Pentexed some time.

I would just play more with the deck and see what is important to change. If you feel the deck doesn't flow good enough I would cut it to 80 cards and keep all Dreams.
